source_order: The original case-sensitive 1/4/16 prefixes remain exact; no reranking or substitution.
selector_inputs: fixed original native test selectors and complete test source
fixed task fixtures used in the original before run
original before failure diagnostics and case identities
task_roots: Select every complete original regression function with its decorators and parameter expressions; recursively retain same-module helpers/constants and required fixture definitions. Generated factories without a provable complete fixture closure are explicit blocked sources.
runtime_roots: All project frames in original before failures plus statically resolved targets of every complete fixed selected test/fixture; never an after-derived changed-file set. The before map is the full retained runtime snapshot scope, which is not asserted to be the whole upstream repository.
closure: v1_static_context_closed describes only the implemented static graph: complete source units, lexical globals, before import/receiver/ancestor/constructor bindings, required fixtures, and explicit Python/external object API contracts. It is not a proof of arbitrary Python semantic completeness. Missing globals, unresolved project receivers, dynamic namespaces/loaders, class decorators/metaclasses and module initialization effects block v1.
cython: Use complete lexical source boundaries. Existing Python/Cython twin modules are coupled; a required unresolved boundary is a source-specific blocker.
no_context_rewrite: no source-specific selection tuned to after answers
action: One hash-bound JSON payload of source-unit-local stable line replacements/helper insertions; all edits must be represented in that one complete target and reconstruct all changed runtime files exactly.
fixture_paths: A bounded, non-executing string path interpreter propagates fixed literal test parameters through named helpers, preserves all parameter choices, and includes complete original script/output fixture bytes. Branch-rebound, late-bound, missing, escaping, unapproved or unresolved paths block v1; the 256-choice/abstract-invocation analysis limit changes no experiment budget.
class_headers: A class_header is its exact structural prefix, not a complete class. Required initialization, bases and referenced methods/state writers are separate complete original units; unsupported class construction blocks v1.
task_after_provenance: Some fixed original test/fixture bytes come from the upstream after revision and were already used as task inputs in the retained before run. Runtime after bytes remain excluded from input selection.
interpretation: Admission is representability in a frozen static codec plus exact original tokenizer bounds; training execution remains false until the independent original E5 execution bindings are frozen.
